global.principle: London is low-saturation neutral grey; Beijing is sunlit warm. The phone screen is the color bridge between the two worlds.

london.sky: dense lead-grey overcast; no clear blue or cyan sky

interior_practicals.rule: small pools of dim practical light only; no amber wash

london.materials: muted walnut, smoked glass, dark blue-grey carpet, brushed bronze with restrained reflections

phone_transition.rule: London surroundings remain dark grey while the phone screen carries the first warm light
phone_transition.transition: camera moves through the phone image; warm sunlight gradually replaces grey ambient light

beijing.sun: soft early-autumn afternoon sunlight through studio windows
beijing.materials: pale grey dance floor, mirror wall, wooden barre, golden foliage outside
beijing.emotion: breath, vitality, openness; she becomes the light source in the story
